main_body: Wooden lectern/pulpit box (x7-39, y12-45) with a red cloth panel bearing a gold cross, a book on top, and a staircase on the right as a side detail
top_band: light orange rows 12-16 (about 4-5 rows) across the full width, then a darker brown step at row 16-17 before the front face
evidence: Down the middle column: white book and red cloth at rows 8-11, a light orange top band at rows 12-15, a darker edge at row 16, then the front face from row 17 to 41. The front face has a dark inset frame (dark top and left edges) around the red panel, and a dark base plinth at rows 42-45. The top band is thin, but it is several rows of lighter tone, with a step and a shaded band below it, so it matches the cabinet guide (top about 5, edge, eave). The staircase is a side element and is not judged.

style.evidence: The wood has about 5 steps, with a dark-brown outline that fits the material, and the frame is shaded. The red cloth panel is a large flat fill of about 14x14 px with only a left highlight. The staircase side is mostly flat tan with a few dots. There is little grain or speckle on the wood. Tiles carry fewer colours than the reference stall and well, which have per-tile texture. It reads as thinner and flatter than the references.
